title: Depth Perception: A dozen technology trends shaping business and IT in 2010
notes: First edition. 12 trends in two categories, Emerging Enablers (1-6) and Disruptive Deployments (7-12). Read from the Wayback Machine copy of the Deloitte Global PDF. The preface places all trends in 2010 ('technology trends we see as relevant for 2010'); horizon and target_year carry that edition-level statement. Quotes are the chapter subtitles unless noted. Published month not stated in the PDF.

entries.label: Information Management Finally Goes Enterprise
entries.quote: Leaders expect confident answers to fundamental business questions. Step one is the right foundation.
entries.subject: Enterprise information management
entries.horizon: 2010 (edition title: 'trends shaping business and IT in 2010')
